upgrade.title: Hali ham “very good”mi?
upgrade.subtitle: Speaking va Writing uchun darajangizni ko‘taring
upgrade.caption: 📌 Qoida: “very + oddiy sifat” o‘rniga bitta kuchli sifat ishlating. Bunday sifatlar oldiga “very” qo‘yilmaydi: ❌ very exhausted → ✅ absolutely exhausted. 🗣 Misol: I was exhausted after the exam, but delighted with my score.

upgrade.title: Phrasal verb o‘rniga 1 ta fe'l
upgrade.subtitle: Writing Task 2 da rasmiyroq yangraydi
upgrade.caption: 📌 Speakingda phrasal verb'lar tabiiy va yaxshi. Lekin Writing Task 2 da bitta rasmiy fe'l kuchliroq yangraydi. ✍️ Misol: Governments should consider ways to improve public transport.

upgrade.title: Speakingda fikr bildirish
upgrade.subtitle: “I think” ni har gapda takrorlamang
upgrade.caption: 📌 “I think” xato emas, lekin har javobda takrorlansa Lexical Resource bali tushadi. Har safar boshqasini ishlating. 🗣 Misol: Do you like reading? — Oh, I'm really into it, especially detective novels.

upgrade.title: Bog‘lovchilarni almashtiring
upgrade.subtitle: Coherence & Cohesion balingiz uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Ehtiyot bo‘ling: however odatda yangi gap boshida keladi va undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. ❌ I like it, however it is expensive. ✅ I like it. However, it is expensive.

upgrade.title: Task 1: grafikni tasvirlash
upgrade.subtitle: Chiziqli grafik va jadvallar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Fe'lga ravish qo‘shsangiz, tasvir aniqroq bo‘ladi: increased steadily (barqaror o‘sdi), dropped slightly (biroz tushdi). ✍️ Misol: Sales peaked at 80% in 2015 and then declined gradually.

upgrade.title: “A lot of” ni unuting
upgrade.subtitle: Miqdorni aniqroq va rasmiyroq ifodalang
upgrade.caption: 📌 Diqqat: a number of + sanaladigan ot (students), an amount of + sanalmaydigan ot (money). ✍️ Misol: A significant proportion of young people work part-time.

upgrade.title: “Good” va “bad” dan voz keching
upgrade.subtitle: Essayda aniqroq sifatlar ishlating
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu sifatlar ko‘pincha predlog bilan keladi: beneficial to, detrimental to. ✍️ Misol: Excessive screen time is detrimental to children's eyesight.

upgrade.title: Speaking Part 1: “Yes” dan keyin
upgrade.subtitle: Qisqa javob o‘rniga tabiiy boshlang
upgrade.caption: 📌 Part 1 da faqat “Yes” yoki “No” deb to‘xtamang. Boshlovchi iboradan keyin yana 1–2 gap qo‘shing. 🗣 Misol: Do you cook often? — More often than not, yes. I usually make dinner for my family.

upgrade.title: His-tuyg‘ularni aniq ayting
upgrade.subtitle: “very sad” o‘rniga bitta kuchli so‘z
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu so‘zlar Speaking Part 2 dagi “Describe a time when…” savollarida juda kerak bo‘ladi. 🗣 Misol: I was absolutely terrified before my first exam, but astonished by my result.

upgrade.title: Odamni tasvirlang
upgrade.subtitle: “Describe a person” savollari uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bitta sifat yetarli emas: uni misol bilan isbotlang. 🗣 Misol: My teacher is really approachable. You can ask her anything, even after class.

upgrade.title: Joyni tasvirlang
upgrade.subtitle: Shahar, park, kafe haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 bustling ijobiy (jonli, gavjum), crowded esa ko‘pincha salbiy ma'noda keladi. 🗣 Misol: The old town is bustling during the day but surprisingly tranquil at night.

upgrade.title: Oddiy fe'llarni kuchaytiring
upgrade.subtitle: Writing Task 2 uchun rasmiy variantlar
upgrade.caption: 📌 Speakingda “get” va “buy” tabiiy. Rasmiy fe'llar ko‘proq Writingga mos. ✍️ Misol: Social media can exacerbate loneliness rather than enhance friendships.

upgrade.title: Education mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Ta'lim haqidagi essaylar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Education IELTS Writing Task 2 dagi eng ko‘p uchraydigan mavzulardan biri. ✍️ Misol: Regular assessment helps educators identify students who might drop out.

upgrade.title: Environment mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Atrof-muhit essaylari uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu so‘zlar ko‘pincha fe'l bilan juft keladi: tackle air pollution, combat deforestation. ✍️ Misol: Governments must take urgent action to combat deforestation.

upgrade.title: Technology mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Texnologiya haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 hooked norasmiy, Speakingga mos. Writingda addicted to yoki dependent on deng. 🗣 Misol: Smartphones have become indispensable, and many teenagers are hooked.

upgrade.title: Health mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Sog‘liq haqidagi savollar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 “fat” odamga nisbatan qo‘pol eshitiladi. IELTSda doim overweight deng. ✍️ Misol: People who have a poor diet are more likely to put on weight.

upgrade.title: Work mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Ish va kasb haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 be made redundant — ish qisqarishi tufayli bo‘shatilmoq. “fired” esa aybi uchun bo‘shatilganda. 🗣 Misol: My father has a high-pressure job and often puts in long hours.

upgrade.title: Vaqt iboralari
upgrade.subtitle: Writing va Task 1 uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Task 1 da vaqt iboralari trendni aniq ko‘rsatadi. ✍️ Misol: Sales grew rapidly and eventually doubled, while costs rose annually.

upgrade.title: Sabab va natija
upgrade.subtitle: Essayda fikrni bog‘lash uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 leads to va contributes to dan keyin ot yoki -ing keladi: leads to pollution, contributes to improving. ✍️ Misol: Urbanisation leads to congestion, which contributes to air pollution.

upgrade.title: Taqqoslash iboralari
upgrade.subtitle: Task 1 va Task 2 uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 whereas ikki qarama-qarshi faktni bitta gapda bog‘laydi. ✍️ Misol: Men preferred football, whereas women's figures were comparable across all sports.

upgrade.title: Speakingda o‘ylanish iboralari
upgrade.subtitle: Jim qolish o‘rniga shularni ayting
upgrade.caption: 📌 Bu iboralar o‘ylash uchun 2–3 soniya beradi va Fluency balini saqlab qoladi. 🗣 Misol: Hmm, that's a tricky one. I'd say it depends on the person's age.

upgrade.title: City mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Shahar hayoti haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 affordable housing — essaylarda juda ko‘p uchraydigan juftlik. ✍️ Misol: Many residents of the metropolis struggle to find affordable housing.

upgrade.title: Pul haqida gapirish
upgrade.subtitle: Speaking va Writing uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 splash out on norasmiy va Speakingda zo‘r eshitiladi. Writingda spend heavily on deng. 🗣 Misol: I rarely splash out, but I bought exorbitant concert tickets last year.

upgrade.title: Travel mavzusi
upgrade.subtitle: Sayohat haqidagi savollar uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 accommodation sanalmaydigan ot: “accommodations” ❌. Imlosi ham tez-tez xato yoziladi: ikkita c, ikkita m. 🗣 Misol: We went sightseeing all day and the scenery was stunning.

upgrade.title: Sport va hobbi
upgrade.subtitle: Bo‘sh vaqt haqida gapirganda
upgrade.caption: 📌 take up — yangi mashg‘ulotni boshlamoq, give up — tashlamoq. 🗣 Misol: I took up swimming last year, and now I work out three times a week.

upgrade.title: Essay xulosasi
upgrade.subtitle: Conclusion paragrafi uchun
upgrade.caption: 📌 Xulosada yangi fikr qo‘shmang: faqat pozitsiyangizni boshqa so‘zlar bilan takrorlang. ✍️ Misol: Having considered both sides, I believe it is essential that governments act now.

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: Slang ball tushiradi, rasmiy muqobilini ishlating
slang.caption: 📌 Examiner slangni noo‘rin uslub deb baholaydi va Lexical Resource bali tushadi. ❌ The movie was mid, no cap. ✅ Honestly, the film was rather mediocre.

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: Qisqartmalar chatda bo‘ladi, imtihonda emas
slang.caption: 📌 Speakingda “gonna” deb talaffuz qilish mumkin, lekin Writingda faqat to‘liq shakl yoziladi. ❌ I'm gonna explain why… ✅ I am going to explain why…

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: Joy va ovqat haqida gapirganda
slang.caption: 📌 Speaking Part 2 da kafe, restoran yoki biror joyni tasvirlaganda juda kerak bo‘ladi. ❌ The food was bussin' and the vibe was great. ✅ The food was delicious and the atmosphere was cosy.

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: Odamlarni tasvirlaganda
slang.caption: 📌 “Describe a person you admire” savoli uchun tayyor so‘zlar. ✅ My close friend has incredible charisma. She's a real role model for me.

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: Yutuq va muvaffaqiyatsizlik haqida
slang.caption: 📌 “Describe an achievement” mavzusida ishlating. ❌ I took an L in my first test. ✅ I faced a setback in my first test, but later I excelled.

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: His-tuyg‘ularni ifodalaganda
slang.caption: 📌 His-tuyg‘u so‘zlari Speaking Part 1 va 2 da ko‘p kerak bo‘ladi. ❌ The trip was lit but kinda cringe. ✅ The trip was thrilling, though slightly embarrassing at times.

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: Fikr bildirganda
slang.caption: 📌 Do‘stingizga “fr fr” deysiz, examinerga esa “honestly”. Gap uslubda. ✅ Honestly, in my view, this trend is quite concerning.

slang.title: Imtihonda bunday xato qilmang!
slang.subtitle: Internet tilini akademik tilga o‘giring
slang.caption: 📌 Technology va social media essaylari uchun foydali. ✅ Young people should spend more time outdoors instead of endless scrolling.

emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: imtihon juda oson o‘tganda shunday deyiladi 😉

emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: notanish odamlar bilan suhbatni boshlash.

emoji.explanation: the elephant in the room — hamma biladigan, lekin hech kim gapirmaydigan muammo.
emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: hamma biladigan, lekin hech kim gapirmaydigan muammo.

options: kill two birds with one stone

emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: Speaking Part 1 dagi “What do you do at weekends?” savoliga zo‘r javob.

emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: Speaking Part 1 dagi “Are you a morning person?” savoliga javob.

emoji.explanation: a night owl — kechasi bedor, kech yotadigan odam. Early bird ning teskarisi.
emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: o‘tgan haftadagi topishmoqning teskarisi 😉

emoji.explanation: time is money — vaqt bu pul. Vaqtni behuda sarflamaslik haqida.

emoji.explanation: a couch potato — kun bo‘yi divanda televizor ko‘radigan dangasa odam.

emoji.explanation: the tip of the iceberg — muammoning faqat ko‘rinib turgan kichik qismi. Essaylarda juda foydali.

emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: Speaking Part 3 dagi “What makes people successful?” savoli uchun.

emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: globalizatsiya haqidagi essaylarning sevimli iborasi.

emoji.explanation: tuition fees — o‘qish uchun to‘lov. “scholarship” esa grant, ya'ni o‘qish uchun beriladigan pul.
emoji.caption: 💡 Ishora: universitetga to‘lanadigan pul.

truefalse.sentence: I am agree with this opinion.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. agree — fe'l, oldiga “am” qo‘yilmaydi. To‘g‘ri: “I agree with this opinion.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: agree fe'lmi yoki sifat?

truefalse.sentence: He gave me some useful advices.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. advice sanalmaydigan ot, -s olmaydi. To‘g‘ri: “some useful advice” yoki “a piece of advice”.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: advice so‘zini sanash mumkinmi?

truefalse.explanation: ✅ To‘g‘ri! depend doim “on” bilan keladi. “It depends of” deyish xato.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: depend qaysi predlog bilan keladi?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. explain something TO someone. To‘g‘ri: “She explained the rule to me.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: explain fe'lidan keyin so‘zlar qaysi tartibda keladi?

truefalse.sentence: I have been to London last year.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. Aniq o‘tgan vaqt (last year) bilan Past Simple ishlatiladi: “I went to London last year.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: last year qaysi zamonni talab qiladi?

truefalse.sentence: The number of students has increased.
truefalse.explanation: ✅ To‘g‘ri! “The number of” + birlik fe'l (has). Lekin “A number of students have…”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: the number of birlik fe'l bilan keladimi yoki ko‘plik?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. people — ko‘plik. To‘g‘ri: “People are becoming more health-conscious.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: people birlikmi yoki ko‘plik?

truefalse.sentence: I look forward to hear from you.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. look forward to + -ing. To‘g‘ri: “I look forward to hearing from you.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: look forward to dan keyin fe'l qaysi shaklda keladi?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. interesting — biror narsa qiziq, interested — siz qiziqasiz. To‘g‘ri: “I'm interested in music.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: interesting va interested farqi nimada?

truefalse.explanation: ✅ To‘g‘ri! good AT + ot yoki -ing. “good in cooking” deyish xato.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: good so‘zidan keyin qaysi predlog keladi?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. Yosh “be” bilan aytiladi: “I am 20 years old” yoki shunchaki “I'm 20.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: inglizchada yosh qaysi fe'l bilan aytiladi?

truefalse.sentence: Can you borrow me your pen?
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. lend — qarzga bermoq, borrow — qarzga olmoq. To‘g‘ri: “Can you lend me your pen?”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: borrow va lend farqi.

truefalse.explanation: ✅ To‘g‘ri! everyone birlik fe'l oladi (has), lekin “their” ishlatish mumkin va tabiiy.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: everyone birlikmi yoki ko‘plik?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. To‘g‘ri: “He suggested that I apply” yoki “He suggested applying.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: suggest fe'lidan keyin qanday tuzilma keladi?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. “since” bilan Present Perfect kerak: “I have lived in Tashkent since 2015.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: since 2015 qaysi zamonni talab qiladi?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. information sanalmaydi: “The information is useful.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: information so‘zini sanash mumkinmi?

truefalse.sentence: I am used to waking up early.
truefalse.explanation: ✅ To‘g‘ri! be used to + -ing — biror narsaga o‘rganib qolmoq.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: be used to dan keyin fe'l qaysi shaklda keladi?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. better allaqachon qiyosiy daraja, “more” ortiqcha. To‘g‘ri: “much better”.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: better o‘zi qanday daraja?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. discuss predlogsiz keladi: “We discussed the problem.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: discuss fe'lidan keyin predlog kerakmi?

truefalse.sentence: If I would have time, I would go.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. If qismida “would” ishlatilmaydi: “If I had time, I would go.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: shart gapning if qismida qaysi zamon keladi?

truefalse.sentence: Neither of the answers is correct.
truefalse.explanation: ✅ To‘g‘ri! “Neither of” + birlik fe'l (is) rasmiy va to‘g‘ri variant.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: neither of birlik fe'l bilan keladimi?

truefalse.explanation: ✅ To‘g‘ri! Lekin Speakingda “I'm really into reading” desangiz, yanada tabiiy eshitiladi.
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: hobby is dan keyin -ing shakli kela oladimi?

truefalse.sentence: I didn't went to school yesterday.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. didn't dan keyin fe'lning 1-shakli keladi: “I didn't go to school yesterday.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: didn't dan keyin fe'l qaysi shaklda bo‘ladi?

truefalse.sentence: There is many reasons for this.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. reasons ko‘plik: “There are many reasons for this.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: reasons birlikmi yoki ko‘plik?

truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. marry predlogsiz keladi: “She married a doctor.” Yoki: “She got married to a doctor.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: marry fe'lidan keyin predlog kerakmi?

truefalse.sentence: Although it was raining, but we went out.
truefalse.explanation: ❌ Xato. although va but bitta gapda birga kelmaydi: “Although it was raining, we went out.”
truefalse.caption: 💡 Ishora: although va but bitta gapda birga kela oladimi?

redflag.title: Writing Task 2 odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Yodlangan gapni examiner darrov taniydi va u so‘zlar hisobga olinmaydi.
🟢 5 daqiqalik tekshiruv 2–3 ta xatoni ushlab qoladi. Bu yarim ballgacha farq qilishi mumkin.

redflag.title: Speaking odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Examiner yodlangan javobni darrov sezadi va mavzuni almashtiradi.
🟢 Savolni qayta so‘rash mutlaqo normal, buning uchun ball tushmaydi.

redflag.title: Listening odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Audio faqat bir marta qo‘yiladi. Bitta savolda qolib ketsangiz, keyingi 3–4 savolni ham o‘tkazib yuborasiz.
🟢 “s” harfi tushib qolsa ham javob xato hisoblanadi.

redflag.title: Reading odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Readingda 60 daqiqada 40 ta savol bor, hamma so‘zni tushunishga vaqt yetmaydi.
🟢 Har passage uchun 20 daqiqa chegarasi vaqtni boshqarishning eng oddiy usuli.

redflag.title: Task 1 odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Task 1 da fikr so‘ralmaydi. “I think this is good” kabi gap Task Achievement balini tushiradi.
🟢 Overview'siz javob 5.5 dan yuqori baho olishi qiyin.

redflag.title: So‘z yodlash odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Miya kontekstsiz so‘zni tez unutadi.
🟢 “make a decision” kabi juftlikda yodlangan so‘z nutqda o‘zi chiqib keladi.

redflag.title: Mock test odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Tahlilsiz test faqat vaqt oladi.
🟢 Bitta test va 1 soatlik tahlil 3 ta tahlilsiz testdan ko‘proq foyda beradi.

redflag.title: Imtihon kuni odatlari
redflag.subtitle: Qaysi biri sizda bor? Rostini ayting
redflag.caption:
Nega bu muhim?
🚩 Charchagan miya Listening va Readingda diqqatni tez yo‘qotadi.
🟢 Oxirgi kecha yangi narsa o‘rganmang, yaxshi dam oling.

collocation.subtitle: Collocation: so‘zlar juftligi
collocation.caption:

Bonus savollarning javobini izohda yozing ✍️

collocation.subtitle: Collocation: so‘zlar juftligi
collocation.caption:
💡 Ishora: “harakat qilmoq”. Writing va Speakingda juda ko‘p ishlatiladi.

Bonus savollarning javobini izohda yozing ✍️
collocation.explanation: make an effort ✅ Bonus: do a favour, take a break.

collocation.title: Qaysi fe'l to‘g‘ri keladi?

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: Describe your hometown.
band.band5: My hometown is Samarkand. It is very beautiful. There are many old buildings. I like it very much.
band.band8: I'm from Samarkand, a city steeped in history. It's renowned for its breathtaking architecture, especially the Registan.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ steeped in history — tarixga boy ▫️ renowned for — … bilan mashhur ▫️ breathtaking — hayratlanarli 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: Do you like your studies?
band.band5: Yes, I like my studies. It is interesting. But sometimes it is very difficult.
band.band8: Overall, I find my course rewarding, although it can be quite demanding during exam periods.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ rewarding — qoniqish beradigan ▫️ quite demanding — ancha og‘ir, ko‘p kuch talab qiladigan ▫️ exam periods — imtihon mavsumi 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: How do you usually spend your weekends?
band.band5: On weekends I sleep a lot. Then I meet my friends. We go to cafe.
band.band8: I usually have a lie-in on Saturdays, then catch up with friends over coffee in the city centre.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ have a lie-in — kech turmoq, to‘yib uxlamoq ▫️ catch up with — ko‘rishib, gaplashib olmoq ▫️ over coffee — qahva ustida 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: Does technology make life easier?
band.band5: Yes, technology is very good. We can do many things fast. But it has bad sides too.
band.band8: By and large, yes. It streamlines everyday tasks, though we've become overly dependent on our devices.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ By and large — umuman olganda ▫️ streamlines — soddalashtiradi ▫️ overly dependent — haddan tashqari qaram 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: Describe a person you admire.
band.band5: I admire my father. He is very kind and hardworking. He helps everyone.
band.band8: I really look up to my father. He's incredibly down-to-earth and has a strong work ethic.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ look up to — hurmat qilmoq, o‘rnak olmoq ▫️ down-to-earth — kamtar, oddiy ▫️ work ethic — mehnatga munosabat 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: Is it important to learn English?
band.band5: Yes, English is very important. Many people speak English. It helps to find job.
band.band8: Absolutely. English is the lingua franca of business, so it opens doors to far better career prospects.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ lingua franca — umumiy muloqot tili ▫️ opens doors — imkoniyat eshigini ochadi ▫️ career prospects — martaba istiqbollari 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: What kind of music do you like?
band.band5: I like pop music. It is very nice. I listen it every day.
band.band8: I'm really into upbeat pop. It instantly lifts my mood, so it's always on while I study.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ I'm really into — juda yoqtiraman, qiziqaman ▫️ upbeat — quvnoq, tetik ▫️ lifts my mood — kayfiyatimni ko‘taradi 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

band.title: Bitta savol, ikki xil javob
subtitle: Surib ko‘ring: avval Band 5, keyin Band 8
Farqni ko‘ryapsizmi?
band.question: Should students wear uniforms?
band.band5: I think yes. Uniform is good because all students are same. It is cheap.
band.band8: I'd say so. Uniforms create a sense of equality and spare parents the expense of trendy clothes.
band.caption: 📚 Band 8 so‘zlari tarjimasi: ▫️ a sense of equality — tenglik hissi ▫️ spare parents the expense — ota-onani xarajatdan qutqaradi ▫️ trendy — zamonaviy, urfdagi 💡 Band 5 javobda oddiy so‘zlar takrorlanadi. Band 8 da esa aniq va kuchli iboralar bor.

pov.question: Do you like pets?
pov.better: Yes, I'm a huge animal lover. I've had a cat for five years and she's the best company after a long day.
pov.lesson: Bir so‘zli javob Fluency balini tushiradi. Formula: javob + sabab + misol.

pov.question: What do you do?
pov.better: I'm a second-year student at university, majoring in economics. It's demanding, but I really enjoy it.
pov.lesson: “I'm student” emas, “I'm a student”. Artiklni tashlab ketish eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato.

pov.question: Do you like your hometown?
pov.bad: Yes, I like. Because it is beautiful.
pov.better: Absolutely. It's steeped in history, and I love wandering around the old town in the evenings.
pov.lesson: “I like” dan keyin to‘ldiruvchi kerak: I like it. “Because” bilan alohida gap boshlanmaydi.

pov.question: You have one minute to prepare. Please start.
pov.better: I'd like to talk about… What I remember most is… Looking back, I think…
pov.lesson: Part 2 da 2 daqiqa gapirish kerak. Tayyor “ko‘prik” iboralar gapni tabiiy uzaytiradi.

pov.question: Why do young people use social media so much?
pov.better: That's an interesting question. I suppose it keeps them connected with friends, and it's also a huge source of entertainment.
pov.lesson: Part 3 da “I don't know” o‘rniga o‘ylanish iborasini ayting va taxmin qiling.

pov.question: Do you enjoy cooking?
pov.better: Not really, to be honest. I'm hopeless in the kitchen, so I usually leave it to my mum.
pov.lesson: “No” ham javob bo‘la oladi, faqat sababini qo‘shing. Salbiy javob ham yaxshi ball oladi.

pov.question: What's the weather like in your country?
pov.better: It varies a lot. Summers are scorching, often over 40 degrees, while winters can be quite chilly.
pov.lesson: “very hot” o‘rniga aniq sifat ishlating. “while” bilan taqqoslash javobni boyitadi.

pov.question: Do you read books?
pov.better: I do, but mostly on my phone. I've recently got into self-help books, like Atomic Habits.
pov.lesson: Savoldagi so‘zlarni takrorlamang: “I do” deng va yangi ma'lumot qo‘shing.
